articles.title: Chrishell Stause announces split from G Flip after 4 years together
articles.summary: Chrishell Stause has revealed that she and partner G Flip are separating after more than four years together.
articles.body: Chrishell Stause has revealed that she and partner G Flip are separating after more than four years together. The 45-year-old actor and reality television star shared the news about the breakup in a tearful video uploaded to Instagram Monday. “I have a pretty humbling update to share with you guys,” Stause began. “G and I are no longer together, and we have agreed to treat this public separation with love and respect for each other.” She continued, “That’s not hard for me because I am in love with this person, and I don’t have all the information or the reasons.” The “Selling Sunset” alum said she hoped that as time goes on she will heal and learn from the relationship. “Everything’s going to be fine. I’m definitely never doing this again,” she said. Stause was previously married to actor Justin Hartley from 2017 to 2021. She explained that she recorded the video message because fans “deserved a little bit more than a cold written statement” after showing their love and support for the couple for years. She said their fans can still offer support, but they will have to do so separately now. “I don’t know what else to say, you guys. I feel like a little bit of a failure. There’s nothing you could say about me that would be worse than what I say to myself. So I just have to kind of heal and figure this out,” Stause said as she started to cry. She further explained how she is currently processing the breakup. “I’m a lover girl. I swing big. I miss…” she said before correcting herself. “Or maybe you don’t miss. Maybe these are the lives and seasons you’re meant to have with people, and I had an amazing over four years with G.” Although the relationship is ending in a way she didn’t expect, she added that she will always love her ex and wishes them both happiness. G Flip posted a statement on their Instagram page that read, “After 4+ years Chrishell and I are no longer together. I will always love her, we will always share a special connection and I cherish our memories together deeply. My head & heart are feeling very heavy right now and I’m not able to talk but I want to thank you all for your support and appreciate you respecting our privacy at this time.” Stause and G Flip, 33, met at a Halloween party in 2021, the Australian musician revealed to Vogue Australia. “Chrishell got stood up and then we ended up kissing,” they shared. The actor confirmed their relationship during the Season 5 “Selling Sunset” reunion in May 2022. “I recently have been spending a lot of time with someone that’s very important to me. Their name is G Flip,” Stause said at the time. “They’re nonbinary, so they go by they/them, and they are an extremely talented musician.” A year later, they married in a surprise wedding. Stause posted a video on Instagram of them tying the knot. The clip included a montage of their relationship. “Love doesn’t always go as planned … Sometimes it’s immeasurably better,” she said in the caption, in part. They continued to have more ceremonies over the past few years. In July 2025, they exchanged vows for a fourth time during their medieval-themed nuptials in Los Angeles. Stause’s representative confirmed to TODAY.com at the time that the ceremony also marked the couple’s third anniversary.

articles.summary: Actor Vishal is presently focusing on his recovery process after suffering a back injury while shooting an action sequence for his forthcoming film
articles.body: Actor Vishal is presently focusing on his recovery process after suffering a back injury while shooting an action sequence for his forthcoming film 'Purushan.' Vishal is known for doing action sequences in all his movies, and it has been learned that even after suffering an injury, he did not stop shooting. The accident happened while they were shooting a fight sequence in Goa. While this injury made him stop working for some time, he is now recovering well through proper treatment. His recovery has also raised questions about when he will return to the sets of the Sundar C-directed film.Doctors advise three weeks of rest for Vishal after Goa accidentAccording to Cinema Vikatan, Vishal injured his back during an action sequence choreographed by Kanal Kannan in Goa. The scene involved several fighters, and the injury occurred unexpectedly while the sequence was being filmed. Nevertheless, even with the pain, the actor apparently completed the shooting of the day and continued with the shooting the next day since the schedule was almost coming to an end. But with the increase in the pain, he sought the help of some doctors who told him that he should rest for three weeks. The injury even stopped Vishal from attending the South Indian Artistes’ Association general body meeting which took place on September 27. The actor has apparently termed it as an accident.Vishal undergoes physiotherapy as 'Purushan' shooting plans remain in focusVishal is taking medical advice as he has been going through physiotherapy treatment. The crew is hoping that he will join the shoot again after recovering some more and the next one is expected to be held in Chennai. The production team will need to plan the remaining action sequences around the actor's condition. Given the physical demands of the film, his return to the sets will depend on his progress and medical advice. Meanwhile, Vishal is said to have begun hearing scripts for his next project, with a possible announcement expected in the coming months. articles.summary: Kolkata hosts 6th Kisan Swaraj Sammelan Oct 29-31 at Science City, with 600 experts on organic farming, seed sovereignty and human-wildlife conflict.
articles.body: Kolkata: Award-winning agriculturalists like Padma Shri Sabarmatee and Padma Shri Subhash Sharma, and environmentalist Sunita Narain, director-general of Centre for Science & Environment, New Delhi, are set to address the 6th Kisan Swaraj Sammelan, which will be hosted by the city for the first time from Oct 29-31.The three-day conference, organised by Alliance for Sustainable & Holistic Agriculture (ASHA), a network of 400 organisations, farmer groups and experts as part of Agro-Diversity Heritage Festival, will bring together about 600 researchers, farmers and agriculture experts from 23 states at Science City. They will speak on organic and natural farming with a focus on seed sovereignty, crop and weed management, agriculture labour and human-animal conflicts in fields.Hundreds of varieties of traditional crop seeds will be put on display at the conference. Students and professors from different colleges and universities will also be part of the event. State agriculture minister Dudh Kumar Mondal is likely to be present at the inaugural ceremony.Angshuman Das, a member of ASHA, said: “The conference aims to deepen collaboration with diverse stakeholders and share a vision for a farmer-centred agricultural future. articles.title: ‘The Pitt’ star Noah Wyle named ‘Sexiest Man Alive’ for the first time at 55
articles.summary: \"The Pitt\" star Noah Wyle has been named People magazine's 'Sexiest Man Alive' for the first time.
articles.body: "The Pitt" star Noah Wyle has been named People magazine's 'Sexiest Man Alive' for the first time.The actor, 55, leads the drama about emergency room doctors, a show that has earned him two Primetime Emmy awards for outstanding lead actor."I thought that sounded like a prank - just not in a million years did I think that this would be an honor bestowed on me," the actor told the magazine, which has crowned personalities like Denzel Washington, John Krasinski, Patrick Dempsey, Chris Evans, Michael B. Jordan, Idris Elba, David Beckham, Chris Hemsworth, Johnny Depp and Matt Damon in the past.Wyle and his "ER" co-star George Clooney were previously on the cover of the magazine for "Sexy Men of ER". Clooney later went on to claim the Sexiest Man Alive crown twice, in 1997 and 2006.Now, it is Wyle's turn.Wyle said his son was super practical about his father's new title."He was like, 'Oh, this is going to make my life so much harder now. But that's cool, Dad. But also, you invite a lot of haters too'. My older daughter was just like, 'No way, no way'. Because I think she's going to tease me about this for the next 50 years."I hope this changes everything. I hope it's just wine and roses, milk and honey from here on out. No, I don't, but I am going to take a lot of ribbing from friends and family for sure," he added."The Pitt" returns with its third season in January on HBO Max.Last year, the magazine named "Bridgerton" star Jonathan Bailey the Sexiest Man Alive.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: AI must enhance human wisdom, not replace it, says Dr SS Bhatti at an event in city
articles.summary: At an event at Sector 10 Government Museum and Art Gallery for the 18th First Friday Forum (FFF) Oration, eight books authored by Dr Bhatti were launched.
articles.body: At an event at Sector 10 Government Museum and Art Gallery for the 18th First Friday Forum (FFF) Oration, eight books authored by Dr Bhatti were launched. Five personalities for their contributions to education, science, art and literacy, and the donation of 24 books for libraries being established across Punjab, were also felicitated.Delivering his oration titled “Education and Artificial Intelligence: From Knowledge to Awakening”, Dr Bhatti described AI as “Frozen Human Intelligence” and emphasised that technological advancement must remain guided by human values. While acknowledging AI's potential to accelerate research, process information and improve productivity, he stressed that its true worth depended on the wisdom, imagination and ethical responsibility of those using it.Advocating his philosophy of Holistic Humanism, Dr Bhatti called for integrating Humanities, Art, Science and Technology to create a more meaningful educational system. He said education should move beyond the accumulation of knowledge and specialised skills to nurture creativity, critical thinking, compassion and responsible citizenship.A major highlight of the programme was the release of eight books authored by Dr Bhatti. Chief Guest Prof Dr RS Bawa, former Vice-Chancellor and Pro-Chancellor of Chandigarh University and Advisor to its Chancellor, released The Muse of Metaphors, while Prof Dr IS Dua, former Chairman of the Department of Botany, Panjab University, released Dr Surindera Singh Bhatti (Architect, Poet, Educator, Artist, and Mystic).Renowned artist and art educator Prof Prem Singh released My Bosom Buddy, while Engineer ML Garg, known for his efforts to establish libraries and promote literacy across Punjab, released Holistic Humanism. Prof Swati Behl Uppal, Principal of the University Institute of Architecture, Chandigarh University, released FUTURELIGHT.Jasjyot Singh Almast released Wayward Verses (Covid-19 Creativity in Poetry), architect Surinder Bahga released Town Planning and Architecture in India, and Bengaluru-based architect Navita Singh, an alumna of Chandigarh College of Architecture, released Architecture and Art during Maharaja Ranjit Singh's Reign.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Rob Riggle says Hollywood work is disappearing from LA: 'It's the exception now'
articles.summary: Rob Riggle reveals why actors are fleeing Los Angeles as work dries up and shares his dream of moving back to his native Kansas City someday.
articles.body: Rob Riggle said many people in the industry are leaving Los Angeles because the work has moved away. The comedian, who stars in the upcoming holiday horror film "Christmas at the Kringles," told Fox News Digital that getting a job in the city is more the exception than the rule now. "I think a lot has changed, the way things are done," he explained. "I used to be out here because I needed to be available to work here. A lot of the work isn't here anymore. I mean, a lot of it, the work is not here anymore. It's the exception now, if you get to work here. So that's one reason." HOLLYWOOD STAR SOUNDS ALARM OVER DISAPPEARING JOBS AS PRODUCTIONS FLEE CALIFORNIA Riggle said that actors don’t even need to be in L.A. to audition anymore. "They don't even do that anymore. Like you don't get to go in anymore," he said. "You have to put yourself on tape standing in front of a white, opaque wall in your garage, trying to make a selfie video, reading with your neighbor, you know, or whoever's in the house, you know? It's terrible. It's just a terrible way to do business. And for whatever reason, that's what we get after COVID. So that's the new paradigm and it sucks." WATCH HERE: ROB RIGGLE SAYS INDUSTRY WORK IS RARELY WORK IN LA "I used to be out here because I needed to be available to work here. A lot of the work isn't here anymore." The "Stepbrothers" actor added that "obviously there's economic reasons to move out." The 56-year-old told Fox News Digital he would love to move back to his native Kansas City. JANA KRAMER SAYS LOS ANGELES PRICED HER OUT OF THE CHILDHOOD SHE WANTED FOR HER KIDS "I would love to make that happen," he admitted. "I don't know when that's going to happen. I've got some things here in California that need tending to, and maybe when I get to a place, once those things are tended to, I can make that move and, get back to, where — I've got a lot of family and friends back there. That was where I grew up and stuff. So it'd be nice if I could make it happen." WATCH HERE: ROB RIGGLE ON WHY HE DECIDED TO DO HORROR-COMEDY ‘CHRISTMAS AT THE KRINGLES’ Riggle is promoting his new holiday horror-comedy "Christmas at the Kringles," which was actually shot in Los Angeles. In the movie, Riggle plays a character named "Drunk Santa." "So, I knew there was going to be a lot of fun right then just seeing that," he joked. "I was like, ‘Oh this is going to be fun. And then the story, the fact that we're mixing so many genres, comedy, horror, holiday — all kind of thrown into one thing and that I think makes it wildly entertaining all the way through. And then the cast and the director, the producers, like the whole team, I just thought, ‘My gosh, if nothing else, I'm going to have the best time ever, and that matters to me." The cast also includes Ron Livingston, Rachel Bilson, Beverly D'Angelo and Donald Faison. Riggle said his family has their Christmas locked down. articles.title: Saif Ali Khan, Vidya Balan reunite for Ritesh Batra’s ‘Long Years Ago’ as filming begins in Mumbai
articles.summary: Filmmaker Ritesh Batra has begun principal photography for 'Long Years Ago', a comedy-drama starring Saif Ali Khan, Vidya Balan and French actor Melanie
articles.body: Filmmaker Ritesh Batra has begun principal photography for 'Long Years Ago', a comedy-drama starring Saif Ali Khan, Vidya Balan and French actor Melanie Laurent.Set in 1991, the film is being shot in Mumbai and centres on a family forced to confront the things its members have left unsaid.The project brings Batra, best known for his acclaimed feature 'The Lunchbox' (2013), together with Saif and Vidya, who are reuniting after their debut film together, 'Parineeta.'Laurent, known for her performances in 'Inglourious Basterds' and 'Now You See Me', completes the principal cast announced for the film.Describing the film's central theme, the makers said it tells “the story of a family that has gone too long without saying the things that matter, and what happens when they’re finally forced to find the words.”Saif expressed an immediate connection with the script, highlighting the filmmaker's ability to tell intimate stories that resonate with audiences across cultures.“Ritesh has an extraordinary gift for telling deeply personal stories that resonate across cultures. Long Years Ago is a film about love, family, and the things we often struggle to say to one another, and I felt an immediate connection to it. Collaborating with Melanie, Vidya, and this exceptional team is exciting, and I can’t wait for audiences around the world to experience this deeply moving story,” the actor said, as per a press statement cited by Deadline.Batra also shared his enthusiasm for working with the three actors.“I am tremendously honoured to be working with Saif, Vidya and Melanie, and to see these great actors bring characters that are so close to my heart to life,” the filmmaker said.For Vidya, the film marks an opportunity to collaborate with Batra, whose work she has admired since 'The Lunchbox', while also reuniting with Saif after Parineeta, her first film.“I’m absolutely thrilled to be a part of Ritesh Batra’s next film. I’ve been a huge admirer of his work ever since The Lunchbox, and have been hoping to collaborate with him for the longest time. There’s such a beautiful sensitivity and honesty to his storytelling. What makes this even more special is that I get to reunite with Saif after Parineeta, my very first film! I can’t wait to experience the magic of working with both Ritesh and Saif,” she said.Laurent, meanwhile, recalled meeting Batra at the Marrakech Film Festival 15 years ago and their shared aspiration to work together in Mumbai.“I met Ritesh fifteen years ago at the Marrakech Film Festival, and we shared this dream to meet in Mumbai one day. I immediately loved this new project, and I am more than honoured and happy to be a part of it,” she said.'Long Years Ago' is a collaborative venture from Adeel Ahmed and Ritesh Batra’s film and television outfit, 'Poetic License', in partnership with Jio Studios and Good Chaos.Jyoti Deshpande is producing the film on behalf of Jio Studios. Good Chaos team members Mike Goodridge and Teresa Moneo, along with Siddharth Mehra, are serving as executive producers.Batra earned international recognition with 'The Lunchbox', which starred Irrfan Khan, Nimrat Kaur and Nawazuddin Siddiqui.He subsequently directed international projects including 'The Sense of an Ending' and 'Our Souls at Night', featuring Robert Redford and Jane Fonda.Principal photography for 'Long Years Ago' has now begun in Mumbai. articles.title: Keanu Reeves replaces Alan Ritchson in action thriller ‘Maelstrom’ directed by Jaume Collet-Serra
articles.summary: Hollywood star Keanu Reeves is set to headline the upcoming Netflix action film 'Maelstrom', taking over the lead role from 'Reacher' star Alan Ritchson,
articles.body: Hollywood star Keanu Reeves is set to headline the upcoming Netflix action film 'Maelstrom', taking over the lead role from 'Reacher' star Alan Ritchson, who has exited the project for undisclosed reasons.Deadline confirmed the news that Keanu Reeves is now set to lead the feature, which is directed by Jaume Collet-Serra, known for his work on Carry-On.In 'Maelstrom', Keanu Reeves will play a Federal Marshal assigned to protect the fiancée of an arms dealer turned witness.According to Deadline, the character must defend her through one brutal night as a hurricane cuts off communication, strands them without reinforcements, and unleashes the dealer’s men on their safe house.The current draft of the script is written by Mark Bianculli, following an initial draft by the late Gregory Fitzpatrick.The project has a lengthy history in Hollywood, having originally been set up as a spec script at Warner Bros. back in 1993.Jeff Robinov is set to produce alongside Tabitha Shick of Talking Pictures.Coming off the fourth instalment of the 'John Wick' franchise, Reeves has continued to expand his active slate of projects.His upcoming ventures include entering talks to lead James Wan’s take on the South Korean crime actioner 'The Gangster', 'The Cop', 'The Devil' for Paramount, reprising his voice role as Shadow in 'Sonic the Hedgehog 4', and starring in an adaptation of the forthcoming Oliver Lowe novel Kill Current: A Jon Hendricks Thriller under his new banner, Two Dragonflies.Additional upcoming projects for Reeves include the Warner Bros. sci-fi film 'Shiver' and 'The Entertainment System Is Down' from director Ruben Ostlund.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
